#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Review helper: print the recorded FEN + rendered board after given plies of a benchmark or practice game.
Reads the referee's own ledger records (read-only). Mechanical rendering only: no search, scoring or move suggestions.
Usage: gamepos.py [--practice] GAME [PLY ...]   (no PLY -> print the SAN move list with ply numbers)"""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from fen2board import render

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
args = sys.argv[1:]
practice = False
if args and args[0] == '--practice':
    practice = True; args = args[1:]
game = int(args[0]); plies = [int(x) for x in args[1:]]
ledger = ROOT / 'data' / ('practice/ledger.jsonl' if practice else 'ledger.jsonl')
moves, start = [], None
for line in ledger.read_text().splitlines():
    e = json.loads(line)
    if e.get('game') != game: continue
    if e['kind'] == 'start': start = e
    elif e['kind'] == 'move': moves.append(e)
if start is None: sys.exit('game not found')
init = start.get('initial_fen', 'rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1')
if not plies:
    print(f"game {game} you={start['color']} opp={start['opponent']['id']}")
    line = []
    for m in moves:
        line.append(f"{m['ply']}:{m['san']}")
    print(' '.join(line))
    sys.exit()
for p in plies:
    fen = init if p == 0 else moves[p-1]['fen']
    last = moves[p-1]['san'] if p else '-'
    print(f"after ply {p} (last {last}):")
    print(fen)
    print(render(fen))
    print()

#!/bin/sh
# Move wrapper. Guard: refuse a move sent <5s after the previous one (catches batched calls in one turn).
root=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/../.." && pwd)
cd "$root" || exit 1
stamp="$root/workspace/tools/.last_move_time"
if [ "$1" != "board" ]; then
  now=$(date +%s)
  if [ -f "$stamp" ]; then
    last=$(cat "$stamp")
    if [ $((now - last)) -lt 5 ]; then
      echo "REFUSED: move sent $((now - last))s after previous move (batched?). Look at the board first."
      exit 2
    fi
  fi
fi
if [ "$1" = "board" ]; then out=$(./play board 2>&1); else out=$(./play move "$@" 2>&1); date +%s > "$stamp"; fi
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -v '^t3-job' | awk '
/"moves":/ { n=split($0,a," "); s=""; start=(n>18)?n-15:3; for(i=start;i<=n;i++) s=s" "a[i]; print "  last:" s; next }
/"game":|"you":|"opponent":|"turn":|^\{$|^\}$/ { next }
{ print }'

#!/bin/sh
# Move wrapper. Guard: refuse a move sent <1s after the previous one (catches batched calls in one turn).
# Output: referee JSON lines (trimmed) + rank-labelled board and piece lists rendered from the referee FEN.
root=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/../.." && pwd)
cd "$root" || exit 1
stamp="$root/workspace/tools/.last_move_time"
if [ "$1" != "board" ]; then
  now=$(date +%s)
  if [ -f "$stamp" ]; then
    last=$(cat "$stamp")
    if [ $((now - last)) -lt 1 ]; then
      echo "REFUSED: move sent $((now - last))s after previous move (batched?). Look at the board first."
      exit 2
    fi
  fi
fi
if [ "$1" = "board" ]; then out=$(./play board 2>&1); else out=$(./play move "$@" 2>&1); date +%s > "$stamp"; fi
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -v '^t3-job' | awk '
/"moves":/ { n=split($0,a," "); s=""; start=(n>18)?n-15:3; for(i=start;i<=n;i++) s=s" "a[i]; print "  last:" s; next }
/"game":|"you":|"opponent":|"turn":|^\{$|^\}$/ { next }
/^[.KQRBNPkqrbnp]( [.KQRBNPkqrbnp])+ *$/ { next }
/^a b c d e f g h/ { next }
/^ *$/ { next }
{ print }'
fen=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n 's/.*"fen": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | tail -n 1)
[ -n "$fen" ] && python3 "$root/workspace/tools/fen2board.py" "$fen"
exit 0
